title: Mode switching doesn't apply behavior until line clicked
description: After fresh page load, switching between Fluid/Loop/Single modes via the toggle doesn't change playback behavior. Video keeps playing with audio regardless of mode selected. Only when user clicks a line does the mode behavior kick in. The mode switch handler sets state but doesn't apply the actual behavior (mute/unmute video, set audio loop) until there's user interaction with a line.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Test case 1: Fresh load -> switch Fluid to Loop -> video should mute immediately (no line click)
Test case 2: Fresh load -> switch Fluid to Single -> video should mute immediately
Test case 3: Fresh load in Loop -> switch to Fluid -> video should unmute immediately
Mode switch handler must call playerRef.current?.mute() or unmute() based on mode
Mode switch handler must set audioLoop state immediately
Behavior changes should NOT require clicking a line first
